name: The Horned Apostle
desc: Gather tanks, healers and damage dealers. Clear six void chambers, defeat Morgrath, then face the Horned Apostle.

guide.title: Void chambers
guide.text: Six rooms of void creatures. Pull one group at a time; the tanks hold them in the middle so the healers can reach everyone.

guide.title: Morgrath
guide.text: A gatekeeper. Tanks swap when his armor break reaches 3 stacks; everyone else stays behind him.

guide.title: The Horned Apostle
guide.text: Rises from the floor, then uses its void skills. At 50% it opens a black hole: run out of its pull and don't stand in the purple circles. Save healing cooldowns for the explosion at the end.
